QuestInfo.name: [Omega Sector] Operations Test
QuestInfo.0: Dr. Kim has a plan to return the M-Forcers to their original size, which required infiltrating an alien Mothership. You headed to Boswell Field 1 with the mini M-Forcers.
QuestInfo.1: Test the mini Mesotron's performance by defeating Mateons in Boswell Field 1 in preparation for the actual mission.
QuestInfo.2: You tested the mini Mesotron's performance by defeating Mateons in Boswell Field 1 in preparation for the actual mission. You should speak with Porter.
